facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 13 January 2026 examined the 2026 budget of the Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualite (ADN) at 134.9 million FDJ, up from 112.1 million in 2025, and stated that in 2025 the ADN made two technical standardisation committees operational, for agri-food products and for electrical and household-appliance products; no IT or data standard is mentioned.
facts.system: Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualité (ADN)

systems.system: Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualité (ADN)

note: No certification fact: the document names no certifier and no certification against an IT or data standard; the committees named cover non-IT products.

facts.fact: Decree 2022-092/PR/MCT of 4 May 2022 organises the ADN, a public industrial and commercial body under the Ministry of Commerce and Tourism, and calls it the national reference body for drawing up standards, charged with preparing and approving standards, certification of conformity and accreditation of conformity-assessment bodies; no IT or data standard is named.
facts.system: Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualité (ADN)

note: No certification fact: the decree gives the ADN a certification mandate but names no certification against an IT or data standard and no certified organisation.

facts.fact: Law 100/AN/20/8th L of 7 January 2021 creates the Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualite (ADN) as a public industrial and commercial body attached to the Ministry of Commerce, the national reference body for drawing up standards, in charge of preparing and approving standards and certifying conformity to them; the passages seen name no IT or data standard.
facts.system: Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualité (ADN)

note: No certification fact: the law gives a certification mandate but names no certifier-held certificate against an IT or data standard; passages only.
Does not state the agency was set up by law or issued any IT standard.

facts.fact: ISO states ADN was created and put into operation in 2022 by Decree No. 2022-092/PR/MCT as the national standards body, developing and monitoring standards.
Djibouti's arrete 2024-139/PRMCT cites law 100/AN/20 of 7 January 2021 creating the Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualite (ADN), which coordinates national standardisation committees.
